description: This dataset compiles archaeological chronologies from Borneo, featuring radiocarbon and uranium-thorium dates from sites in Indonesia and Malaysia. It includes spatial identifiers for countries and provinces, alongside laboratory labels and dating methods. The data provides raw and calibrated age measurements with standard deviations, enabling researchers to analyze temporal trends in prehistoric human occupation. By linking these dates to specific archaeological sites and academic references, the dataset supports studies on regional cultural development, migration patterns, and the timeline of technological advancements in Island Southeast Asia.
